Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )
    
    
)

        )

    )

    )

    )

        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    )

    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))

        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))

        (forever ?x)

    )

        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))

    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    )

        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )

        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    )

        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

        (forever ?x)

        ;;Process Mining

    )

        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity

        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )

        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )

        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

        :parameters (?s - activity)

    )

    )

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation

        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

        :parameters (?s - activity)

    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )
    
    
)

        )

    )

        :precondition ()

    )

        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time

        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    )

        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))

    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )

        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

        :parameters (?s - activity)

    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )
    
    
)

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )
    
    
)

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

        (forever ?x)

    )

        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    )

        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )

        :precondition ()

    )

    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)

        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace

    )

        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))

    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state

        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )

## Hybrid Problem Definition

### Domain and Objectives

The problem is defined using the provided PDDL (Problem Definition Language) domain and objectives.

```pddl
(domain reasoners)
```

### Predicates

The following predicates are used:

* `deadlock_free`: checks if a process has a deadlock-free schedule.
* `has_pieces`: checks if a process has a certain number of pieces.
* `has_time`: checks if a process has a certain amount of time.
* `produced_from`: checks if a process produces a certain item.
* `next_activity`: checks if the next activity is active.
* `target_activity`: specifies the target activity.
* `state`: checks if a process is in a certain state.
* `reachable`: checks if a process is reachable from another process.
* `eventually_reachable`: checks if a process is eventually reachable from another process.
* `trace`: checks if a process has been traced.
* `stay`: checks if a process stays in a certain state.
* `forever`: checks if a process is forever running.
* `validate_deadlock`: checks if a process has a deadlock-free schedule.
* `validate_reachable_state`: checks if a process is reachable from another process.
* `validate_trace`: checks if a process has been traced.
* `validate_stay_in_state`: checks if a process stays in a certain state.
* `validate_forever_state`: checks if a process is forever running.
* `validate_reachable_from_state`: checks if a process is reachable from another process.
* `maintenance`: checks if an activity is being maintained.
* `extract_digital_twin`: extracts the digital twin of a process.

### Actions

The following actions are available:

* `simulate_time_with_activity`: simulates a process with a specific activity and returns the result.
* `simulate_pieces_with_activity`: simulates a process with a specific activity and returns the result.

        (forever ?x)

    )

        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)

    )

    )

        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )

        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

        :parameters (?s - activity)

                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

        (forever ?x)

    )

    )

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

## Hybrid Problem Definition

### Domain and Objectives

The problem is defined using the provided PDDL (Problem Definition Language) domain and objectives.

```pddl
(domain reasoners)
(:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

(:types
    input process output activity - object
)
```

### Predicates

The following predicates are used:

* `deadlock_free`: checks if a process has a deadlock-free status.
* `has_pieces`: checks if a process has a certain number of pieces.
* `has_time`: checks if a process has a certain amount of time.
* `produced_from`: checks if a process produces a certain item.
* `next_activity`: checks if the next activity is active.
* `target_activity`: specifies the target activity.
* `simulation_done`: indicates that simulation has been completed.
* `digital_twin`: checks if a process has a digital twin.
* `requires_maintenance`: checks if an activity requires maintenance.
* `is_maintained`: checks if an activity is maintained.
* `simulation_done`: indicates that simulation has been done.
* `reachable`: checks if a state is reachable.
* `reachable_from`: checks if a state is reachable from another state.
* `eventually_reachable`: checks if a state is eventually reachable.
* `forever`: indicates that a state is forever reachable.
* `validate_deadlock`: checks if a process has a deadlock-free status.
* `validate_reachable_state`: checks if a state is reachable.
* `validate_reachable_state_with_time`: checks if a state is reachable with a certain amount of time.
* `validate_eventual_reachable_state`: checks if a state is eventually reachable.
* `validate_trace`: checks if a state has a trace.
* `validate_stay_in_state`: checks if a state stays in its current state.
* `validate_forever_state`: checks if a state is forever reachable.
* `validate_reachable_from_state`: checks if a state is reachable from another state.
* `maintenance`: checks if an activity is being maintained.
* `extract_digital_twin`: extracts the digital twin of a process.

### Actions

The following actions are available:

* `simulate_time_with_activity`: simulates a process with a specific activity and returns the result.
* `simulate_pieces_with_activity`: simulates a process with a specific activity and returns the number of pieces produced.
* `simulate_next_activity`: simulates the next activity in the process.

        (forever ?x)

        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)

        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    )

    )

    )

    )

        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)

    )

    )

        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )

        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)

        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )
    
    
)

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

    (:types

    )

        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

    )

        ;; Verification

        (reachable ?x)

        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types

    )

        ;; Verification

        (reachable ?x)

        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance

        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

    )

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation

        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )
