Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )
    
    
)

        (forever ?x)

        ;;Process Mining

    )

        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    )

    )

        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)

    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )

        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

    )

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    )

    )

        :effect (and (forever ?x))

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

        :effect (and (forever ?x))

    )

        ;; Verification

        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance

        (is_maintained ?s - activity)

        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

        :parameters (?s - activity)

    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

    )

        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)

    )

    )

        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()

    )

        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )

        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

        :parameters (?s - activity)

                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    )

    )

        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    )

        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )

        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

        :effect (and (forever ?x))

        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))

        (forever ?x)

        (is_maintained ?s - activity)

        ;;Process Mining

    )

        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )

        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )

        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

    )

        :effect (and (forever ?x))

        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

    )

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation

        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)

        ;; Verification

        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation

        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)

        ;; Verification

        (reachable ?x)

        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )

        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock

        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)

    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )

        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

    )

  (let ((input (first params))
        (process (second params)))
    (cond
       ((deadlock-free-p input) (return-from simulate (progn (simulate-time-with-activity input) (simulate-process input process)))
       (t (do-while (not (deadlock-free-p input)) (simulate-time-with-activity input) (simulate-process input process))))

      (defun simulate-time-with-activity (input)
        (let ((time (first (second input)))
              (state (second (third input))))
          (if (> time 0)
              (progn
               (setf time (- time 1))
               (setf state (next-state state))
               (simulate-time-with-activity input state)
               (return-from simulate-time-with-activity state)
              )
             (return-from simulate-time-with-activity state)))

        (case state
           (input :when (has-maintenance state) (return-from next-state (next-activity state))
            (input :else (return-from next-state state))
           (output :when (produced-from state) (return-from next-state state))
           (output :else (return-from next-state state))
           (error "Invalid state")
          ))

    (:types

    )

        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )
    
    
)

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation

        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

        (forever ?x)

        )

    )

        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )

        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    )

    )

        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

    (:types

    )

        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates

        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )

    )

        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )

        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    )

Here is the context: (define (domain reasoners)
    (:requirements :strips :typing :conditional-effects :action-costs) 

    (:types
        input process output activity - object
    )
    (:predicates
        ;; Simulation
        (deadlock_free ?x - process) 
        (has_pieces ?x)
        (has_time ?x)
        (produced_from ?x ?y)
        (next_activity ?x ?y)
        (target_activity ?s - activity)
        ;; Verification
        (state ?x)
        (reachable ?x)
        (reachable_from ?x ?y)
        (eventually_reachable ?x)
        (trace ?x)
        (stay ?x)
        (forever ?x)
        ;; Maintenance
        (requires_maintenance ?s - activity)
        (is_maintained ?s - activity)
        (simulation_done)
        ;;Process Mining
        (digital_twin ?x - process)
    )

    (:action simulate_time_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_pieces ?x) (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_time ?z) (produced_from ?x ?z) (simulation_done))
        )

    (:action simulate_pieces_with_activity
        :parameters (?x - input ?s - activity ?y - process ?z - output)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (has_time ?x)  (target_activity ?s) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (has_pieces ?z) (produced_from ?z ?x) (simulation_done))
    )

    (:action simulate_next_activity
        :parameters (?x - activity  ?z - activity ?y - process)
        :precondition (and (deadlock_free ?y) (digital_twin ?y))
        :effect (and (next_activity ?x ?z))
    )
    
    (:action validate_deadlock
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (deadlock_free ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_reachable_state_with_time
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_eventual_reachable_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (eventually_reachable ?x))
    )

    (:action validate_trace
        :parameters (?x - output ?y - output)
        :precondition (and (has_time ?x))
        :effect (and (trace ?y))
    )

    (:action validate_stay_in_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (has_time ?y))
        :effect (and (stay ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_forever_state
        :parameters (?x - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x))
        :effect (and (forever ?x))
    )
    
    (:action validate_reachable_from_state
        :parameters (?x - input ?y - input)
        :precondition (and (state ?x) (state ?y))
        :effect (and (reachable_from ?x ?y))
    )
    
    (:action maintenance
        :parameters (?s - activity)
        :precondition (and (requires_maintenance ?s) (simulation_done))
        :effect (and (not (requires_maintenance ?s))
                    (is_maintained ?s))
    )

    (:action extract_digital_twin
        :parameters (?x - process)
        :precondition ()
        :effect (and (digital_twin ?x))
    )
    
    
)
